input.subject: Re: Quick question - Pricing and implementation options

bodyParts.intro: Thanks for reaching out. I hear the urgency—backing up tickets with unhappy customers is exactly the kind of situation Zendesk is built to help you resolve quickly.
questions: To recommend the right plan tier and get you accurate pricing, could you share roughly how many support tickets you handle per month and how many agents would need access?
bodyParts.closing:
On implementation: Zendesk is designed for fast setup. Most teams are up and running within days, not weeks—we offer implementation checklists, launch guides, and training resources to help you hit the ground running.

Per the published Zendesk catalog pricing, Suite plans start at $55 per agent/month (Team tier), with Growth at $89 and Professional at $115. These include the core channels you'd expect—email, help center, and messaging depending on the tier.

Let me know those details and I can point you to the right fit for your situation.
